name: Pill Outline Sliding Tab Bar

description.zh: 整体是一条细黑描边的全圆角胶囊容器，内部等距排列大写无衬线标签，字距舒展、留白充裕。选中项以实心黑胶囊反白文字呈现，与容器描边形成黑白双层的极简对比。
description.en: A fully rounded pill container drawn with a thin black outline holds evenly spaced uppercase sans-serif labels with generous letter spacing. The active item becomes a solid black pill with reversed white text, creating a crisp two-layer black-and-white contrast against the outlined shell.

reconstructionPrompt: A horizontal pill-shaped tab bar with a thin black outline on a white background, containing evenly spaced uppercase sans-serif labels. The active tab is a solid black pill with white reversed text that slides horizontally to sit under the hovered label; inactive labels remain black on white. Generous letter spacing, roomy padding, fully rounded ends, flat and monochrome with no gradients or shadows.
